reason: At $24.99 it's close to what I'd pay for Toplux, and the named lab report plus the money-back if I finish the box takes the risk out. I'd grab one box, but only because of the launch price.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and I already have a drawer of half-used bottles, so I'm scared this becomes another one I quit after a week.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price weren't there and it was full $29.99 for the first box, I'd scroll past.
